The background is plain white.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen mimics the structure of a webpage but consists of illegible glyphs and pseudo-text rather than readable characters. This is a common AI artifact where text structure is preserved but semantic content is lost.

The stylus appears slightly warped or melted near the tip, lacking the rigid, straight geometric precision expected of a plastic pen. The shadow underneath is also somewhat diffuse and inconsistent with the sharp lighting on the device.
The transition between the grey protective case and the inner device bezel is slightly blurry and indistinct, suggesting a minor fusion or lack of clear physical separation.
